content: Linear Agents platform: agents triggered by @mention (app:mentionable) or delegation via assignee menu (app:assignable). Delegation sets agent as DELEGATE not assignee; human stays owner. AgentSession created automatically; AgentSessionEvent webhook actions: created, prompted (follow-up in agentActivity.body). Agent must emit a thought activity within 10s of created or the session is marked unresponsive; sessions go stale after 30min without activity. Activity types: thought, action, elicitation, response, error. elicitation is the only type that flips session to awaitingInput. response and error are terminal and auto-create a comment. Both scopes require an OAuth app installed with actor=app (workspace admin required) — a personal-API-key bot user gets no AgentSession webhooks and cannot create AgentActivity.
